import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static class ModInt {
        int val;

        ModInt(long v) {
            if (v < 0) {
                v = v % MOD + MOD;
            }
            if (v >= MOD) {
                v %= MOD;
            }
            val = (int) v;
        }

        static int modInv(int a, int m) {
            int g = m, r = a, x = 0, y = 1;
            while (r != 0) {
                int q = g / r;
                int temp = g % r;
                g = r;
                r = temp;
                temp = x - q * y;
                x = y;
                y = temp;
            }
            return x < 0 ? x + m : x;
        }

        ModInt(int v) {
            val = v;
        }

        ModInt add(ModInt other) {
            val += other.val;
            if (val >= MOD) val -= MOD;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt subtract(ModInt other) {
            val -= other.val;
            if (val < 0) val += MOD;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt multiply(ModInt other) {
            val = (int) ((long) val * other.val % MOD);
            return this;
        }

        ModInt divide(ModInt other) {
            return multiply(other.inverse());
        }

        ModInt add(long other) {
            val += other;
            if (val >= MOD) val -= MOD;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt subtract(long other) {
            val -= other;
            if (val < 0) val += MOD;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt multiply(long other) {
            val = (int) ((long) val * other % MOD);
            return this;
        }

        ModInt inverse() {
            return new ModInt(modInv(val, MOD));
        }

        ModInt pow(long p) {
            assert p >= 0;
            ModInt a = new ModInt(val);
            ModInt result = new ModInt(1);
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) {
                    result.multiply(a);
                }
                a.multiply(a);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
            ModInt modInt = (ModInt) o;
            return val == modInt.val;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return val;
        }
    }

    static class SafeHash {
        private static final long FIXED_RANDOM;

        static {
            long seed = System.nanoTime();
            FIXED_RANDOM = splitmix64(seed);
        }

        static long splitmix64(long x) {
            x += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15L;
            x = (x ^ (x >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9L;
            x = (x ^ (x >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebL;
            return x ^ (x >> 31);
        }

        public int hashCode(Object key) {
            long x = key instanceof Long ? (Long) key : ((Integer) key).longValue();
            return (int) splitmix64(x ^ FIXED_RANDOM);
        }
    }

    static class LongModIntMap {
        private final Map<Long, ModInt> map = new HashMap<>();

        void put(Long key, ModInt value) {
            map.put(key, value);
        }

        ModInt get(Long key) {
            return map.get(key);
        }

        void add(Long key, ModInt value) {
            ModInt existing = map.get(key);
            if (existing == null) {
                map.put(key, value);
            } else {
                existing.add(value);
            }
        }

        Set<Map.Entry<Long, ModInt>> entrySet() {
            return map.entrySet();
        }

        void clear() {
            map.clear();
        }

        int size() {
            return map.size();
        }
    }

    static final int N_MAX = 10;
    static int N;
    static ModInt[][] probability = new ModInt[N_MAX][N_MAX];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        N = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());

        String[] line;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            line = br.readLine().split(" ");
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                int p = Integer.parseInt(line[j]);
                probability[i][j] = new ModInt(p).divide(new ModInt(100));
            }
        }

        List<List<Integer>> masksWithCount = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            masksWithCount.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }

        int[] lookup = new int[1 << N];
        Arrays.fill(lookup, -1);

        for (int mask = 0; mask < 1 << N; mask++) {
            int count = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            lookup[mask] = masksWithCount.get(count).size();
            masksWithCount.get(count).add(mask);
        }

        LongModIntMap possibleMasks = new LongModIntMap();
        possibleMasks.put(1L << lookup[0], new ModInt(1));

        for (int left = 0; left < N; left++) {
            LongModIntMap newPossibleMasks = new LongModIntMap();
            ModInt[] products = new ModInt[1 << N];
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << N); i++) {
                products[i] = new ModInt(1);
            }

            for (int current = 0; current < 1 << N; current++) {
                for (int right = 0; right < N; right++) {
                    if ((current >> right & 1) == 1) {
                        products[current].multiply(probability[left][right]);
                    } else {
                        products[current].multiply(new ModInt(1).subtract(probability[left][right]));
                    }
                }
            }

            long[] newBits = new long[N];
            long[] newPossible = new long[1 << N];

            for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> entry : possibleMasks.entrySet()) {
                long possible = entry.getKey();
                ModInt prob = entry.getValue();

                Arrays.fill(newBits, 0);

                for (int mask : masksWithCount.get(left)) {
                    if ((possible >> lookup[mask] & 1) == 1) {
                        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                            if ((mask >> i & 1) == 0) {
                                newBits[i] |= 1L << lookup[mask | 1 << i];
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                newPossible[0] = 0;

                for (int current = 1; current < 1 << N; current++) {
                    newPossible[current] = newPossible[current & (current - 1)] | newBits[Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(current)];
                    newPossibleMasks.add(newPossible[current], prob.multiply(products[current]));
                }
            }

            possibleMasks = newPossibleMasks;
        }

        ModInt answer = new ModInt(0);
        for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> entry : possibleMasks.entrySet()) {
            if ((entry.getKey() >> lookup[(1 << N) - 1] & 1) == 1) {
                answer.add(entry.getValue());
            }
        }

        System.out.println(answer.val);
    }
}
